questions.name: Photo Any Building Visible From Transit Station
questions.description: Send me a photo of any building visible from your transit station. Must stand directly outside a station entrance. If multiple, choose one. Must include roof and both sides, with the top of the building in the top 1/3 of the frame.

questions.name: Photo Widest Street
questions.description: Send me a photo of the widest street/path you can see. Must include both sides of the street/path.

questions.name: Photo Tree
questions.description: Send me a photo of a tree. Must include the entire tree.

questions.name: Tallest Structure In Your Sightline
questions.description: Tallest building from your perspective, not objectively tallest. Must include top and both sides. Top must be in top 1/3 of the frame.

questions.name: You
questions.description: Send me a photo of yourself. Selfie mode, perpendicular to ground, arm extended, default lens, no zoom.

questions.name: The Sky
questions.description: Send me a photo of the sky. Place phone on ground, shoot directly up, no zoom.

questions.name: Trace Nearest Street/Path
questions.description: Send me a photo tracing the nearest street or path. Street/path must be visible on mapping app; trace intersection to intersection (use photo editing app or tracing on paper)
